lightbox.$description: Lightbox's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--lightbox-<name>) on the page, a container or one Lightbox, and every Lightbox inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

stage-bg.$description: The stage behind a picture while it loads, or if it fails.

caption-color.$description: The caption and the count (4.5:1 on the dialog).

fallback-color.$description: The broken-image icon when a picture fails.

edge.$description: A faint line around the picture, so a white one stays apart from a white dialog.

stage-max-height.$description: Space kept free above and below the stage: the title, the arrows and the screen's edges (160px).

gap.$description: Space between the picture, its caption and the arrows (12px).
